name: train-trust
description: Train Trust: Community-Zug-App (statisches HTML/JS-Frontend, PHP-API, SQLite)

scripts.cap:add: npm run build:www && cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.aab:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
